_comment: The client's Easter Company sign-in is the site's own sign-in, copied byte for byte. Every entry below is a file served to the page by desktop/signin.cjs; tests/company-signin.test.cjs checks each sha256 against the copy in this tree on every run, and cmp's each one against the site's own file whenever a site checkout is available (EASTER_SITE_DIR, or /root/easter-co-smp.github.io/site). Nothing in this list is edited by this client: the seam, the skin and the two DOM adjustments live in desktop/signin-adapter.mjs, desktop/signin.css and desktop/signin.cjs.

desktop/vendor/launcher/signin-options.m.note: The copy this client has carried since its first release, byte identical to the site's. It is served as /signin-options.mjs so the page's imports resolve, and the client keeps one copy of it rather than two.

desktop/vendor/launcher/account-client.m.note: Imported by the site's account/microsoft-signin.mjs, which the page loads even though this client never starts that flow: the import has to resolve. Same reason as above for keeping the client's existing copy.
